encounters.intro_image_prompt: Wide atmospheric shot of an ancient garden at the edge of dawn. A rock-cut tomb with a large round stone rolled aside sits in the middle ground, dark opening visible. Olive trees and low shrubs surround it. The sky is deep indigo fading to the faintest amber on the horizon. A lone small figure in a dark violet headscarf walks toward the tomb from the far left, barely visible against the landscape. No text. Painterly warm 2D illustration, Mediterranean palette, deep indigo and muted violet tones, cinematic lighting.
